targets.recommended_epistemic_category_note: Not substrate_ceiling. The tested mechanism is BUILT and demonstrably firing; the criterion was vacuous because the gate's operating point was dead or saturated on 2/3 seeds. Recording this as a ceiling would suppress GOV-GRAN-1 surfacing and mark MECH-122 not-v3-testable on the strength of a criterion that could not vary.

overrides_manifest_direction.basis: The manifest self-routed `weakens` off a 0/3 C1b. The gate clamp(mel/ref-1,0,1) was DEAD on seed 42 (mel/ref-1 = -0.135,-0.401,-0.036,-0.085, all clamp to 0, so the mel_pe fix contributed nothing and the run silently reverted to the legacy `recency` path 861a already showed flat) and SATURATED on seed 123 (+0.623,+1.103,+1.162,+1.412 -> 3/4 arms clamp to 1.0, plus an independently degenerate DV). Only seed 456 spanned a usable range. The criterion required 2/3 seeds while the mechanism was structurally unable to vary on 2/3, so the 0/3 is vacuous rather than a negative result. An implementation/measurement gap must not demote the claim.

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-861d (confirmed failure_autopsy_861c-861d-mech180-cluster_2026-08-16) -> non_contributory for BOTH claims; MECH-122 status UNCHANGED at provisional. The manifest's self-routed `weakens` on MECH-122 is OVERRIDDEN. The landed follow-up fix (ree-v3 6aa97ca) is confirmed working at its own layer -- mean_spindle_selection_weight now spans ~100x (0.009-0.956 vs 861a's flat ~0.004-0.01), tracks measured MEL, and collapses to ~0.004 on the MEL-OFF control, resolving the 861a flat-weight defect. But the clamp(mel/ref-1,0,1) novelty gate was DEAD on seed 42 and SATURATED on seed 123, so C1b required 2/3 seeds while the mechanism could not vary on 2/3. Seed 123 additionally had 4-6 cycles of insufficient touched slots and a degenerate DV (one arm exactly 0). On the single graded seed (456) the DV moved INVERSELY to selection weight -- flagged as an anomaly to test, not a result. The distinct V3-EXQ-436c ContextMemory.write_gate bias-over-content defect remains open downstream and is the leading candidate explanation.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.severity_note: Classified `corrupting` because the defect produces evidence that LOOKS valid but is not: a clamped gate that is dead or saturated yields a clean-looking 0/3 criterion failure indistinguishable from a real negative result. Any future experiment consuming relative_novelty can silently produce vacuous arms unless it pre-registers an operating-point check. Paths are scoped to the two functions rather than whole files to bound the Step 2.5c gate.

failure_record_entry.metric: DV3 revalidation VACUOUS on 2/3 seeds: relative_novelty gate = clamp(mel/ref-1,0,1) was DEAD on seed 42 (gate range [0.000,0.000]) and SATURATED on seed 123 (3/4 ON arms at 1.0, plus 4-6 cycles insufficient touched slots and one arm DV exactly 0). Only seed 456 spanned a usable range [0.027,0.867]. C1b 0/3 is therefore not evidence about the mechanism. On seed 456 the DV moved inversely to selection weight (wt 0.123->0.761 vs DV 0.0195->0.0120) -- anomaly flagged, leading candidate is the still-open V3-EXQ-436c write_gate bias-over-content defect.

resolves_prior_failure_record.resolved_note: The 861a defect was a uniformly flat selection_weight (~0.004-0.01) traced to ThetaBuffer.consolidation_summary() being self-referentially decoupled from the MEL axis. The named follow-up fix landed as ree-v3 6aa97ca (mech122_novelty_reference_mode='mel_pe') and V3-EXQ-861d CONFIRMS it at its own layer: mean_spindle_selection_weight now spans ~100x (0.009-0.956), tracks measured MEL, and collapses to ~0.004 on the MEL-OFF control. The flat-weight failure mode is closed; the residual blocker is the distinct gate-operating-point and write_gate issues recorded in the new entry above.

learning_extracted: A clamp(x,0,1) gate fails in two opposite directions that both present as a clean negative: DEAD (all-zero, mechanism inert) and SATURATED (all-one, mechanism non-discriminating). Neither is visible from the criterion's pass/fail alone.

A gated mechanism needs a pre-registered operating-point precondition proving the gate spans a usable range on a seed BEFORE that seed's criterion is scored -- the calibration analogue of the dry-run unreachable-criterion trap.

A validated fix can be masked by an independently-known downstream defect: 861d confirmed its own fix while its manifest self-routed `weakens` against the claim, so the positive result was invisible in the headline direction.

Scoring-policy drift across sibling letters (DV3 excluded in 861c, load-bearing in 861d) was legitimate here because the substrate changed between them, but establishing that required a git-history walk -- the manifest should record which substrate state justified the change.

cluster_pattern.shape: Two structurally distinct load-bearing failures at opposite ends of one measurement chain, with a PROVEN middle. 861c fails at the producer/consumer normalisation (C2 calibration noise floor); 861d fails at the selection/write path (C1b spindle_density). In both runs the intermediate stages -- measured MEL, duration factor monotone in measured MEL, selection weight monotone in measured MEL -- are demonstrably working.
cluster_pattern.structural_property: Both failures are the SAME shared normalisation `mel / mel_reference`. Verified: 861c's on_factor equals mel_HIGH/mel_reference exactly (0.8366, 1.2146, 1.8846), and 861d's novelty gate is clamp(mel/ref-1,0,1). The reference is estimated per seed from CALIB_DRAWS=5 at rel_sd 0.15-0.28 and is not reliably positioned below the ecological MEL distribution, so whichever consumer reads it inherits an operating point that is dead, saturated, or graded as a function of seed. This is one buildable calibration defect expressed at two consumption points, NOT a substrate ceiling and NOT two independent bugs.
